title: components: drop the page renderer's retired 'jsx' kind arm once the resolved @objectstack/spec carries objectstack c5dd7fce30 (half 2 of objectui#12464)
body:
Blocked-by: #12626

Filing gate ④ · a split-off half of objectui#12464, as triage `6190403616` prescribes · objectui `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`. ⛔ Not a claim.

Parent: #12464. Its PR #12485 retires the page kind `jsx` from the type (`PageNodeSchema.kind`), the zod face and the console sample (half 1). This card is half 2.

Restart-when: npm view @objectstack/spec@next version names a release built from objectstack c5dd7fce30 or a descendant

## Why it waits

Triage's ruling `6190403616`, half 2, verbatim: "drop it only once objectui's `@objectstack/spec` resolves a `next` built from a commit carrying `c5dd7fce30`. Before that, a server on `next.1` can still serve a stored `jsx` page that spec 18's rehydration would have turned into `html`."

The dev's reading at dispatch (report `6191722258`): `packages/types` and `packages/components` both resolve `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.1`, whose built `ui` kind enum still lists `jsx` (`COMPILED_PAGE_KINDS ['html','jsx']`). `npm view @objectstack/spec@next version` returns `18.0.0-next.1`.

## What to do when it restarts

1. `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx`: drop the renderer's `kind === 'jsx'` arm. Restore the read of `schema.kind` to the authoring type: PR #12485 widened it to `string | undefined` only to keep that arm compiling.
2. Fix the comments that still name `jsx` as live: the `getJsxManifest` comment in `page.tsx`, and the comment on the re-attached spec checks in `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts`.
3. The app-shell server double in `ResourceEditPage.pageRequiresStamp-11357.test.tsx`, which reads `body.kind 'jsx'` and mirrors next.1's `COMPILED_PAGE_KINDS`, follows the resolved spec.
4. Pin that a node with `kind: 'jsx'` is no longer compiled as html.
5. `@object-ui/components: minor`.

Not in scope: the sample's file names (`sdui-jsx-preview.*`), which the dev noted. They describe the parse tier and carry no kind value.
